assets.label: window concrete
assets.description: A tall straight warm-gray concrete wall section with one large rectangular industrial window centered above a waist-high solid sill. Thin olive metal window frame with four panes; the panes are empty see-through openings (no glass reflection or opaque fill). Flat wall top and ends; small chips, rust beneath frame.
assets.orientation: lower-left to upper-right; mirror for other axis
assets.notes: Sight through aperture; surrounding wall remains solid. No glass or climbing mechanics implemented.

assets.label: window brick
assets.description: A tall straight weathered red-brick factory wall section with one wide six-pane industrial window above a waist-high brick sill, slender dark iron mullions, stone lintel. All six pane openings are transparent (no opaque glass or interior), flat wall ends.
assets.orientation: lower-left to upper-right; mirror for other axis
assets.notes: Sight through aperture; surrounding wall remains solid. No glass or climbing mechanics implemented.

assets.label: window corrugated
assets.description: A tall straight rusted corrugated galvanized wall panel with one broad rectangular three-pane window above waist height. assets.orientation: lower-left to upper-right; mirror for other axis
assets.notes: Sight through aperture; surrounding wall remains solid. No glass or climbing mechanics implemented.

assets.label: door steel closed
assets.description: A tall narrow warm-gray concrete wall section containing one CLOSED olive-green solid steel personnel door. Closed leaf fills doorway, visible dark handle and heavy hinges, steel jambs and lintel, chipped paint, small rust streaks. Concrete surrounds match the existing concrete wall sprites.
assets.orientation: lower-left to upper-right; mirror for other axis
assets.notes: Closed pose; opening interaction and matched animation remain integration work.

assets.label: doorway concrete open
assets.description: A tall narrow warm-gray concrete wall section containing one OPEN EMPTY full-height personnel doorway. Concrete side jambs and lintel remain; door leaf entirely absent. Door opening reaches the ground with NO bottom rail or sill, fully transparent through the opening, no wall behind it, no black fill.
assets.orientation: lower-left to upper-right; mirror for other axis
assets.notes: Open passage; not a frame-matched animation pair.
